Sire of 24 Stakes Winners and 42 Stakes Horses to date
, with an outstanding 15.2% Stakes Horses to Starters,
ranking second only to Justify among Kentucky sires of his crop.
• Top 4 Sire of 2 Year Old Stakes Winners in 2026, led by
earning a 94 Beyer Speed Figure –among the top three recorded by a 2 year old filly in 2026.

• Other stakes performers include Grade 2 winner and half-million-dollar earner GROUND SUPPORT (G2), a 3 ¾ length winner of the seven furlong Glen Cove Stakes (G3) at Belmont in 1:20.22 – New Stakes Record and winner of the Pebble Stakes (G3) at Belmont in 1:33.52, .02 off the Stakes Record.
• Commercial Success Year After Year: In 2026, 2 year olds sold for $750,000, $500,000, $350,000, etc.; Yearlings sold for $450,000, $385,000, $385,000, etc.; Weanlings sold for up to $230,000, etc.

• Respected by Leading Buyers: Progeny purchased in 2026 by Katsumi Yoshida, Donato Lanni, St. Elias Stable, West Point Thoroughbreds, Flying Dutchmen, Kenny McPeek, Wesley Ward, Bradley Thoroughbreds, Bill & Corinne Heiligbrodt, among others.
• Loaded Pipeline: Averaged 150 mares bred annually over the last two years, representing his highest-quality books to date.
